title: Lending supply position
description: Supply of the loan asset (e.g. USDC) to an isolated lending market. The lender does not hold the collateral: it loses only what borrowers' collateral no longer covers (bad debt, undercollateralized debt). Its market parameters, including totals and the borrower LTV distribution, are keyed by position_id in the market snapshot.

quantity.description: Supplied amount in loan-asset units (accrued interest included).
